title: BLS OEWS: annual wage percentiles per occupation (SOC) and metropolitan area (WO-036)
source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics, metropolitan and nonmetropolitan area file
what_it_is: What employers in the metro paid workers in the occupation (all employers, all experience levels), from the BLS employer survey. Not entry-level pay and not one employer's pay.
awaiting_reason: Built 2026-10-20 in an environment that could not reach bls.gov, so the OEWS metro file was not downloaded. The importer and its test fixture are in the repo; CI or the owner runs the command above and commits the result.
